title: Choose a Thoughtful Gift
description: Read, hear and send a short message about a birthday gift using useful dative chunks.

data.heading: Who receives it?
data.body: Use dative for the person who receives help, a call or a gift. Learn these as useful chunks.

items.en: I will give a gift to a friend.

data.prompt_en: Who is the gift for and what does she like?
data.transcript_cz: Zítra má Jana narozeniny. Dám kamarádce knihu, protože se jí líbí české příběhy.

data.prompt_en: Read for the recipient, preference and plan.
data.text_cz: Ahoj, kupuju dárek pro Janu. Dám jí českou knihu. Jana ráda čte a tahle kniha se jí moc líbí. Můžeš mi ještě poradit?
data.text_en: Hi, I am buying a gift for Jana. I will give her a Czech book. Jana likes reading and she really likes this book. Can you advise me too?

questions.question_en: What will the speaker give Jana?

exercises.answer_key: A Czech book; Jana likes reading

pairs.right: I will give her a book

data.sentence: Dám Janě knihu, protože se ___ líbí.
data.explanation: Jí refers to Jana: the person who likes the book.

data.prompt_en: Write 2–3 sentences: name a person, say what you will give them, and say what they like.
data.sample_answer: Dám kamarádce knihu. Líbí se jí české příběhy. Můžeš mi poradit?

data.prompt_en: Record 15–25 seconds: say who the gift is for, what you choose and why.
